title: Emperor Palpatine
subtitle: According to My Design
text: Action [Exhaust]: Choose an exhausted friendly unit. Give an Advantage token to it for each other friendly unit.
deployBox: On Attack: You may choose another exhausted friendly unit. If you do, give an Advantage token to it for each other friendly unit.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 7 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules: Emperor Palpatine's ability gives Advantage tokens equal to the number of friendly units minus 1.
